concern_summary: This concern focuses on the categorization of bills and transactions, allowing users to update and manage their classification effectively based on current editing states and user input.
This concern is centered around the functionalities for integrating with QuickBooks and managing available account options for exporting expenses related to vendor payments and reimbursements.
This concern is focused on managing IOU details during the creation of optimistic IOU report actions, particularly for payment and split scenarios.
This concern involves rendering category shortcut buttons for ease of access, enabling direct user interaction with frequently used categories in a visual manner.
This concern pertains to the visibility and selection of category options, processing user inputs, and dynamically organizing options to enhance user navigation and selection experience.
Handling bill payment requests, including editing comments, managing bill amounts, and navigating through various transaction states.

This concern addresses the management of cancellation types related to bills, determining the current cancellation status based on pending manual cancellations and updating the overall state of the bill detail page.
Management of user reactions on the bill detail page, including tracking the types of reactions, their counts, and the engagement status of the current user.

This concern centers around the encapsulation and presentation of the original message that includes key financial details related to an unapproved report, essential for the interaction on the bill detail page.
Processing and managing split bills among participants, including calculating shares, managing transaction details, and preparing reporting data.
